He's one of the mechs up the road, isn't he?|Stang, to Brasso and then Kellen|}} '''Stang''' was an [[Imperial Army trooper]] in the [[Galactic Empire]], and a [[sergeant]] in a [[Krole's contingent|contingent]] led by [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]] during an [[Imperial Supply Census]] on the [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]] in [[4 BBY]]. When the contingent moved into a new council, Krole left Stang in charge at a [[Mina-Rau General Store|general store]] while he went to take advantage of an [[Bix Caleen|undocumented worker]]. While there, Stang saw the [[stormtrooper]]s under him apprehend the undocumented worker [[Brasso]]. Not long afterward, [[Corporal]] [[Pyke (individual)|Pyke]] called in from Krole's [[Unit One (Galactic Empire)|transport]] to ask for help. Unable to get any response from the corporal, Stang gathered some reinforcements to help the pair. As they moved out on their [[Unit Two (Galactic Empire)|transport]], a [[TIE Avenger prototype]] flew overhead. While the sergeant thought it was on their side, the [[TIE series|TIE]], flown by the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[spy]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], fired a [[torpedo]] at the [[transport]], destroying it with Stang. ==Biography== ===Imperial audit=== {{Quote|Sergeant Stang.''"
"''Yes, sir.''"
"''We'll be back in an hour.''"
"''Understood, sir.|Krole and Stang|}} [[File:Stang-on-duty-Andor203.png|thumb|left|300px|Stang was deployed on Mina-Rau.]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Stang served as an [[Imperial Army trooper]], going on to hold the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[sergeant]]. In [[4 BBY]], he was deployed with [[Imperial Military|forces]] tasked in carrying out an [[Imperial Supply Census]] on the [[Agriworld|agricultural]] [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]],{{Andor|One Year Later}} the first audit on that world in ten [[Standard year|years]]. The Imperials surveyed [[Council Five Hundred]], catching an undocumented individual running during their checks,{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} before going over [[Council Six Hundred]], where a group of undocumented individuals were found hiding. Stang joined a [[Krole's contingent|contingent]] of Imperials moving into a new council the [[Standard day|day]] after, comprised of army [[trooper]]s and [[stormtrooper]]s and led by [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]]. In two Imperial vehicles, [[Unit One (Galactic Empire)|Unit One]] and [[Unit Two (Galactic Empire)|Unit Two]], they went to a [[Mina-Rau General Store|general store]] that Krole and some of his [[troop]]s had visited before. Unbeknownst to the Imperials, the proprietor of the store, [[Kellen]], had secretly been trying to help three undocumented [[Technician|mechanics]]—[[Brasso]], [[Bix Caleen]], and [[Wilmon Paak]]—evade Imperial inspection. As Stang disembarked from Unit Two and looked around, Krole ordered the worker [[Aneth]] to feed the [[soldier]]s, asking for two meals to be saved as he intended to visit Caleen at her nearby [[mobil-haus]] and take advantage of her. [[File:Stang-arrest-Andor203.png|thumb|right|300px|Stang oversaw Brasso being taken into custody.]] Krole left Stang in charge and left on Unit One, driven by [[Corporal]] [[Pyke (individual)|Pyke]], to carry out his intentions with Caleen, stating that he would be back in an [[Standard hour|hour]]. While Stang and the other troops did a sweep, a stormtrooper found Brasso sneaking around, taking him back to the store. As Brasso arrived before Stang, the sergeant remarked that the captured man was not a local, asking Kellen if he was one of the mechanics living up the road. Brasso, intent on protecting Kellen, pretended to believe the store owner had ratted him out and tried to attack him. Stang had the stormtroopers pin the mechanic down, the sergeant telling Kellen that the latter was lucky the Imperials were there. ===Plan gone awry=== {{Quote|Mount up! Six with me, you five with the prisoner!|Stang gathers troops to assist Krole and Pyke|}} While Stang ate with other soldiers inside the general store, Krole attempted to rape Caleen at her mobil-haus, only to be mortally injured by his victim. Hearing the lieutenant's screams, Pyke contacted Unit Two to ask for help, with Stang being summoned to the [[Unidentified troop transport|troop transport]]. The sergeant tried to reach Pyke, to no success, and the soldier that summoned him claimed it sounded like they were under attack. Stang thus ordered his troops to mount up, having three stormtroopers and two Army Troopers stay behind with Brasso. As the [[transport]] made its way toward Krole's position, the lieutenant died of his injuries, and Pyke was gunned down by Caleen. [[File:That-must-have-Stang-Andor203.png|thumb|left|300px|Stang went up in a fireball.]] Additionally, the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[spy]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], a friend of Kellen and the undocumented mechanics, arrived in a stolen [[TIE Avenger prototype]], flying over Stang's transport. Stang asked who called the [[TIE series|TIE]] in, thinking it was one of theirs, while Andor flew back over and fired a [[torpedo]] at the transport, destroying it and all aboard. Andor then killed the rest of the Imperials at the general store as they pursued a fleeing Brasso. The spy was able to rescue Caleen and Paak, but Brasso was killed while trying to escape the Imperial troops. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You're lucky we were here.|Stang, to Kellen, upon Brasso's arrest|}} [[File:Stang-radio-Andor203.png|thumb|right|300px|Stang quickly gathered reinforcements to aid Krole.]] Stang was a [[human]] with [[Color|light]] skin, light brown [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s. Upon Brasso's capture, he quickly deduced that the mechanic was not a local and told Kellen that he was lucky the Imperials were there to catch the undocumented worker. After a distress call from Pyke, the sergeant was quick to try and make contact, and mounted up reinforcements upon the suspicions that their comrades had been attacked. ==Equipment== An Imperial Army trooper, Stang wore a gray [[Clothing|uniform]] featured with pockets on his chest and [[Limb|arms]] and two black stripes below on his left upper arm. He additionally donned a black [[belt]], black [[boot]]s, and a gray [[Imperial kepi]] with black goggles on. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|So proud to be part of such an amazing show. It was genuinely like stepping into another world. And what an unlikely turn of events to be working with my good pal @alexjordanvo after we both sent our audition tapes off whilst on holiday together in 2023. The job of dreams.|James Craze reflects on being a part of ''Andor''|{{Instagram|username=crazejames|url=p/DIvaL-qIoGQ/|name=[[James Craze]]|date=2025-04-22|archiveurl=https://archive.is/1HO8S}}}} Stang first appeared in "[[Harvest]]," the third episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} The character was portrayed by [[James Craze]]. Craze and fellow actor [[Alex Jordan]] originally sent in audition tapes for the show while on holiday together in [[2023]]. Jordan ultimately got a role alongside his friend as "[[Unidentified Imperial soldier 1 (Mina-Rau)|Soldier #1]]." Mina-Rau's outside scenes for ''Andor'' were filmed on [[Pinewood Studios]]' 007 stage.{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-1|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Harvest}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|AE4wxt70aUM|Andor | Season 2 Trailer | Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|duN-KQgOjYs|Andor | Official Trailer | Final Season Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} *{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-1|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia}} *{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=სტენგი (პერსონაჟი) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Imperial Army troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
